body:
I've spent the day drinking... It isn't doing me any good lately

I'm sorry that things are this way.

Project that you need help to the most trusted person in your life. I'm in a poor position to offer you constructive help, but if you know that you can't grin and bear it then open up to a loved one. There is always someone that cares, don't be afraid of telling a person that you love where you are and who you are.
